subject: HANDOFF: exact cover visual lease + closing shader composition R&D
body: Final subsystem: Fold7 cover visual composition/fold-effect ownership. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=FINAL_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e; main did not change during this R&D. Strongest proven finding: privileged V9 intentionally suppresses autonomous cover PanelEngine rendering in all closing states, while DisplayMirrorHost only presents a right-pane bitmap crop/live SurfaceControl mirror and does not invoke DuoShader/FoldOverlayView/TiltFollower; therefore the current Gen2 closing path has no fold-shader producer. Opening remains a separate PanelEngine one-shot and uses service-global earlyOpeningVisualStarted, creating a source-level host-remap ownership risk. Proposed architecture separates cover authority/content from exact visual intent via serviceEpoch+movementId+attemptSequence+direction+contentLeaseId+hostEpoch and explicit hidden readiness vs visible demand. Final pure Kotlin model passed 34/34 tests including a 100,000-event fixed-seed adversarial stream. Initial prototype flaw (shader could activate while hidden-ready) was found and fixed by adding explicit visualDemand/READY_HIDDEN. Android production app NOT compiled in this silo: direct git clone failed DNS; current source was inspected through GitHub connector at exact SHA. Exact Fold7 projection/shader performance remains field-unverified. Manual integration review required; preserve V9 early inner wake, early exact-cycle capture, current cover lease/readiness/frame provenance/presentation owners, geometry, and thresholds.
